Product Description

Pokémon GO Plus + is a new device that uses Bluetooth Low Energy technology to link with the Pokémon Sleep and Pokémon GO smart device apps! With the Pokémon Sleep app, just press and hold the central button on the Pokémon GO Plus + accessory and place it by your pillow. There’s a Pikachu within your Pokémon GO Plus + that can sing you lullabies and act as your morning alarm; Pikachu grows friendlier the more you sleep, unlocking even more sounds! Depending on how you sleep, you can collect more Pokémon to complete the sleep Pokédex! Keep an eye on your sleep data and link to Pokémon GO to take advantage of upcoming gameplay features. With Pokémon GO, use this accessory to spin PokéStops or throw Poké Balls automatically (and Great Balls and Ultra Balls too!). You can catch Pokémon without even pressing a button! Linking the Pokémon GO Plus + with Pokémon GO will also let you take on Special Research to catch a Snorlax with a nightcap.

    It’s not very good at multitasking. It’s better to either set it up to spin stops or catch Pokémon. If you set it up to catch Pokemon I wouldn’t pay attention to your catch log or you’ll see shiny Pokémon running away. Personally I like setting it to spin stops so I can catch the mons without running out of balls.

    It has decent battery life. Although it turns itself off after about an hour of use and you have to turn it back on. It does work without you having Pokémon go on your screen, so you can keep Pokémon go as a background app while doing other things.

    You can’t turn off the vibration or light.

    It’s a good investment if you love the game

  • Caitlin Smith
    5 out of 5 stars
    Just buy it, seriously.
    Reviewed in the United States on July 12, 2025
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    Reading the reviews I was thinking the vibration would be stronger. It’s really not that bad. If you don’t have it on a hard surface you don’t even hear it. And there’s a silent mode which sets it to only vibrate if you’re worried about the pikachu noises.

    This does indeed auto catch Pokemon near you without you pressing the button or doing anything. I misunderstood this part at first when I was doing research on this. It auto throws, without the app being open and without you having to press the button at all. However, it only throws regular pokeballs. Once you run out of those, you have to press the button when it lights up in order to throw either great balls, or ultra balls.

    Another thing I did not know about is that the device does disconnect from pokemon go like every hour or couple hours from inactivity. But, the app will send you a notification telling you to reconnect, which is very helpful.

    One more thing I really like about this, is that the time in which it would take you to throw the ball, is cut in half with this device. Sometimes the constant aiming and throwing is very tedious.

    Overall, I think anyone would be a fool not to buy this if you’re really trying to level up in pokemon go, and you have the money for it.

    I will say, this has made me a bit more desperate to spend money in the app itself in order to get additional storage for items/pokemon, in order to keep up with how quickly you’ll catch Pokemon and spin pokestops.

    The sleep tracking is cool too, you get rewards for just “sleeping”.

    Elevate Your Pokémon GO Experience with the Pokémon GO Plus+!
    Reviewed in the United States on August 30, 2024
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.

    Elevate Your Pokémon GO Experience with the Pokémon GO Plus+!

    The Pokémon GO Plus+ is a must-have accessory for any Pokémon GO enthusiast. This sleek, innovative device has transformed my gameplay, making it more enjoyable and efficient.

    Design and Build: The Plus+ features a compact, ergonomic design that comfortably fits in your hand or clips onto your clothing. The build quality is excellent, with a durable feel that can withstand daily use.

    Functionality: The device excels in automating many in-game actions. It vibrates and lights up to notify you of nearby Pokémon, PokéStops, and Gyms, allowing you to interact without constantly checking your phone. The added functionality of the Plus+ version includes advanced features such as tracking and recording your activities even when the app is not open.

    Ease of Use: Setup was straightforward, and pairing it with the app was quick. The controls are intuitive, making it easy to use during walks or outings. The battery life is impressive, lasting for days on a single charge, which is perfect for long Pokémon hunting sessions.

    Gameplay Enhancement: The Plus+ significantly enhances the Pokémon GO experience by allowing you to catch Pokémon and collect items with minimal effort. It’s incredibly satisfying to see the progress and rewards while focusing on other tasks or enjoying outdoor activities.

    Overall: The Pokémon GO Plus+ is an invaluable addition for any player looking to streamline their Pokémon GO experience. It combines convenience, functionality, and fun, making it a worthwhile investment for both casual players and dedicated trainers. If you want to get the most out of your Pokémon adventures, the Plus+ is definitely worth considering!
